title: pvCrop
body:
## pvCrop

Extracts a sub-block of an image or volume (vtkImageData) given as a point-index extent [imin, imax, jmin, jmax, kmin, kmax]; the output keeps the input origin and spacing, so cropped points stay at their original positions. Use it to cut a region of interest from a large image before costly filtering or export. To cut by world coordinates or with an arbitrary shape use clip; extractSubset selects an index range with sampling rates as well.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Indices are point indices of the input's extent, not coordinates; convert positions with (x − origin) / spacing.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Crop`. Identity: `filters/ImageClip`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Crop filter. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OutputWholeExtent` | This property gives the minimum and maximum point index (extent) in each dimension for the output dataset. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCrop",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
